title: Press Communiqué
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

Press Communiqué

Posted On:
29 MAY 2026 6:47PM by PIB Delhi

In exercise of the power conferred by clause (1) of Article 224 of the Constitution of India, the President is pleased to appoint (i) Smt. Rajeshwari Narayana Hegde, to be an Additional Judge of the Karnataka High Court with effect from the date she assumes charge of her office till her retirement on superannuation on 17.03.2028 and (ii) Smt. Kedambadi Ganesh Shanthi and (iii) Shri Brungesh Mahadevappa, to be
 Additional Judges of the Karnataka High Court for a period of two years
 with effect from the date they assume charge of  their respective offices.

****

Samrat

(Release ID: 2266750)
